purpose: CMA-ES tune of PD's 11 gains plus the allocation's lag_compensation (how hard PD pushes, never when it acts), with a cost for bump air over 8 kg.
baseline: candidates/repo.toml (claude/pd-model-fix: fixed PD, actuator-aware allocation at 0.5)

tuning_seeds.cells: A-F x both modes x plain/randomized (24)

validation_seeds.cells: A-F x both modes x plain/randomized (24)

adoption_rule: beats the repo on validation, no cell worse by more than about 1 point, bump air under 8 kg in both modes
why_chosen: Passes every rule with no cell worse at all, the lowest-but-one bump air (6.22 kg) and moderate gains. 'mean' scored slightly higher under randomization (+5.20 vs +4.94) but sits at search edges (kv 19.4, kp_tumble 66, blend end at the 170 deg cap), stiff enough to risk thruster chatter.

files.tuning_log.txt: best and repo score per generation (tuning objective)
